parameters.name: DomainNames
parameters.description:
The domain names.

>  Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). Up to 100 domain names can be entered.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns bind-instance-domains --lang en --instance-id s00000000 --domain-names example.com,example.net --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns BindInstanceDomains --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId s00000000 --Lang en --DomainNames 'example.com,example.net'
